To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the digital library of the future is a distributed, open, and dynamic system that will be able to support the creation, access, manipulation, and preservation of a wide variety of multimedia documents.

the DILIGENTS approach to digital libraries of the Future will enable the creation of digital library systems that will support the co‐operative and continuous access, filtering, generation, and manipulation of a large variety of documents and data sources that range from text, audio and video documents, to scientific data sets, and databases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What is the nature of the information that is being created in the digital age?
the design and implementation of an integrated digital library system that provides a single, unified, and seamless environment for the access, filtering, and manipulation of multimedia documents.
the design of a digital library infrastructure that supports the creation, access and management of digital libraries in an open, distributed and heterogeneous environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the DILIGEN T infrastructure is a very good candidate for the digital libraries o f the future.
the future of the library is not in doubt, but that its form and function will continue to change and evolve as technology advances and the needs of society change.
the digital libraries of tomorrow will not be a single entity, but a network of cooperating entities, and that libraries will be one of the key players in this network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the digital library of the future will be a large scale infrastructure, based on the integration of many different repositories of content, and will support a wide range of user tasks.
we have developed a new model for the digital library that is based on a new set of technologies, and we have developed a set of prototypes to validate our model.
the paper presents a vision on the future of digital libraries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have a good idea of what digital libraries are, and how to build them.
the digital library community should be more active in defining and developing a vision for the digital library of the future.
the digital library of the future should not only provide access to digital resources and support their preservation, but also support their creation.
